mission.title: Muzzle
mission.description: Find the intruder and try to calm him down.

phase.briefing:
Warrior, the intruder has been out of contact and prone to fits of violence for the past week. This presents a danger to bluepills in the simulation who witness his inexplicable violence; we're also concerned that, without guidance, he may end up doing something even more rash.
I'm sending you after him to try to calm him down. He did not respond well when operatives tried to ask him what was wrong. I would advise just trying to talk to him in some sort of supportive fashion.

enter.say:
Yeah, like talking ever gets us anywhere...
I've got some intruder-style code in there. I'm not sure he's in there himself, but there's only one way to find out.

objective.text: Kill all of the intruder's programs

done.say: Hm.. No big intruder-sized blips so far. Keep going.
Nah, I think he's already ditched. Let's see if Tyndall's picked up anything else.

phase.briefing: He is difficult to track, since he can jump around the Matrix seemingly at will. I'm uploading another set of coordinates for you to try, operative.

enter.say: Yep... Looks like it's time for more high-speed hostility.

objective.text: Kill all of the accelerated programs

done.say:
Bingo, bango, bongo.
So, uh... Got a good icebreaker handy?

talk.say:
I know why you're here... Just stay out of my way!
It's none of your damn business now. I've got some fish to fry.

done.say: Yeah...okay I think we've done all we can and you should just get the hell out of there right now.
I don't like being lied to. Keep your trap shut or you'll be next on my list.

phase.briefing:
At least you got him to talk, operative. For now we'll have to consider that a sign of progress.
I need you to rendezvous with Captain Colt. E Pluribus Neo has a report to relay about their findings at the surface facility where they rescued Commander Lock.

enter.say: Colt's in there, and some other redpills...probably EPN.

talk.say:
We still can't give Mauser a decent burial.
Talk to the Kid, he'll explain.

done.say: Oh, they sent the Kid? All right, let's see what's up.
*Tch.* Tyndall knows I hate it when she calls me "Captain Colt"...

talk.say:
Sentinel claws and lasers had cut a large breach in the structure where Lock was hidden. We found Mauser's fingerprints, and traces of blood that match his samples provided by your people, but we haven't been able to locate his body. It's possible that the Sentinels took it for...recycling.
There were no dead Sentinels near the place, either, but lightning gun scorch marks were everywhere. There was lab equipment of some kind, but it was pretty much completely wrecked. We haven't been able to recover any useful data from the computers that were there.

done.say: Ugh. Hell of a way to go.
I wish we had better news for you. We'll notify you if we find anything else.
... At least he went out fighting. That's more than a lot of people get.

phase.briefing:
Although the facility where EPN found Commander Lock is positioned roughly above Zion, it isn't on any of our records, and we have no sensor or surveillance feeds from the place to indicate what the Sentinels did with Mauser's body.
It may be a little ghoulish, but it would be nice to have the final answer. At this point, the only ones who would have activity records of the area would be the Machines. Intel thinks that a terminal at the location marked on your screen could be used to access recent Sentinel logs.

enter.say:
Okay, that's a Machine facility, so it's safe to say you should expect some static.
... You know, a bad reception?
Hostiles?

objective.text: Get the Data from the Computer

done.say: Alright, we got something. Grab the data and vamoose.

objective.text: Upload the Data at a hardline

mission.finish:
I'm afraid the data you were able to recover didn't contain any record of Sentinel activity at that surface site, {player}, even though the captured log information went back several months. It's possible that the Machines moved those records to a more secure location.
Outbreaks of intruder-spawned violence in the city have decreased since the intruder's initial rampage, and the fact that you were able to communicate with him today, however briefly, may indicate that the immediate threat has passed. We must look for an opportunity to re-establish regular contact with him; although we don't know the exact reason for his behavior, his incredible abilities have already created a new balance of power within the Matrix.
